name: UI & Front-End Layer
description: 300+ standalone HTML applications, stylesheets, and client-side JavaScript that form the user-facing experience of the Consciousness Revolution platform.
purpose: Deliver interactive tools, dashboards, games, payment flows, and information pages directly in the browser with no build step required.
inputs: External SDKs: PayPal, Babylon.js, Three.js, TensorFlow.js
outputs: HTTP requests to /api/* or external services

keyFiles.role: Main hub — project gallery and navigation

conventions: All HTML files are standalone — no build process required
Mobile-first responsive design with viewport meta tag
WCAG AA accessibility: ARIA labels, keyboard nav, color contrast
User inputs are HTML-escaped before DOM insertion
Secrets are never stored in HTML/JS — fetched from /api/* at runtime
